name: COVERAGE_5
description: The COVERAGE_5 table contains high-level information on both managed care and indemnity coverage records in your system.

columns.name: CVG_ID
columns.description: The unique identifier (.1 item) for the coverage record.

columns.name: COBA_STATUS_C_NAME
columns.description: The Coordination of Benefits Agreement (COBA) status for E01 file generation.

columns.name: COBA_DELETE_EFF_DATE
columns.description: When the Coordination of Benefits Agreement (COBA) status in COBA_STATUS_C is DELETE or ADD+DELETE, this holds the effective date that is to be marked as deleted on the E01 file.

columns.name: PLAN_MAPPING_SKIP_OLD_CVG_ID
columns.description: The source coverage that the plan swap was performed on to create this coverage

columns.name: PLAN_MAPPING_SKIP_STATUS_C_NAME
columns.description: Stores the current status of plan mapping skip behavior

columns.name: PLAN_MAPPING_SKIP_DATE
columns.description: The date that the plan swap took place.

columns.name: PLAN_MAPPING_SKIP_USER_ID
columns.description: The user that last updated the plan mapping skip status

columns.name: PLAN_MAPPING_SKIP_USER_ID_NAME
columns.description: The name of the user record. This name may be hidden.

columns.name: MCARE_GENDER_IDENTITY_C_NAME
columns.description: The gender identity denoted by the subscriber on their Medicare Advantage application.

columns.name: MCARE_SEX_ORIENTATION_C_NAME
columns.description: The sexual orientation denoted by the subscriber on their Medicare Advantage application.
entries: Straight, that is not gay or lesbian

columns.name: MCARE_SPEC_GENDER_IDENTITY
columns.description: The term the subscriber specified for their gender identity on their Medicare Advantage application because a value for their gender identity was not present on the application.

columns.name: MCARE_SPEC_SEX_ORIENTATION
columns.description: The term the subscriber specified for their sexual orientation on their Medicare Advantage application because a value for their sexual orientation was not present on the application.

columns.name: MCARE_INDIV_REP_NAME
columns.description: The name of the individual representative that helped the subscriber fill out their Medicare Advantage application.

columns.name: MCARE_INDIV_REP_REL_C_NAME
columns.description: The relationship of the individual representative to the subscriber that they helped fill out the Medicare Advantage application for.

columns.name: MCARE_INDIV_REP_NPN
columns.description: The National Producer Number of the individual representative that helped the subscriber fill out the Medicare Advantage application, if the individual representative is an agent or a broker.
